name: seg_no
description: Segment number within the machine series (index into segments.csv, seg_no); -1 outside every segment

name: phase
description: 0 outside a segment, 1 ramp, 2 steady, 3 end, 4 inside a segment without a named phase (blip, short, no steady level found, too few valid rows, or an edge hidden by a data hole)

name: op_state
description: 0 boring (inside a segment), 1 cutterhead turning without boring, 2 cutterhead not turning, 3 cutterhead speed missing
